paper.title_en: A q-analogue of Mirzakhani's recursion for Weil-Petersson volumes
paper.abstract_en: We define q-analogues of Mirzakhani's recursion for Weil-Petersson volumes and the Stanford-Witten recursion for super Weil-Petersson volumes. Okuyama recently introduced a q-deformation of the Gaussian Hermitian matrix model which produces quasi-polynomials that recover the Weil-Petersson volumes via a rescaled q to 1 limit. The q-deformations of the Weil-Petersson volumes produced here agree with the top degree terms of Okuyama's quasi-polynomials and suggest a variation of Okuyama's methods to the super setting.
